sources: Sources: Reuters, Associated Press, CNN, SCMP, Gulf News, FIFA, Wall Street Journal — 23 Nov 2026. Figures as reported on the day; casualty counts may be revised.

stories.headline: Nvidia Brings Huang Back as CEO
stories.summary: Board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang 11 days after he quit; Trump calls it "the correct and proper decision" as shares jump 33%.

stories.headline: Iran's Tanker Gambit Tests US Blockade
stories.summary: Tehran readies 14 tankers to test the US blockade as 31 laden tankers already sit beyond the strait; seven have been hit since 16 Nov.

stories.headline: US Offers Manila $2.4B Defence Deal — With a Catch
stories.summary: Washington offers over $2B in loans plus $400M in financing for South China Sea deterrence — but Manila must buy American.

stories.headline: SpaceX Sets 32-Hour Pad Turnaround Record
stories.summary: Falcon 9 flies NROL-136 just 32 hours, 3 minutes after USSF-317 left the same Vandenberg pad, beating the old 45-hour record.

stories.headline: Four Nations to Host 2031 Women's World Cup
stories.summary: FIFA awards the first 48-team, 104-match Women's World Cup to the US, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica; the UK gets 2035.

stories.headline: Mexico Captures 'Chapo Isidro'
stories.summary: FBI Top-10 fugitive Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores is seized in a Friday-night raid on Guasave; four soldiers and seven gunmen are killed.

subtitle: Monday, 23 November 2026 · Six stories that defined the day
